name: Aman Tokyo
description: High above the Japanese capital, Aman Tokyo offers serene, minimalist luxury. It features vast, light-filled rooms drawing inspiration from traditional Japanese residential design with Washi paper doors and deep soaking tubs overlooking the skyline.

name: The Brando
description: An exquisite eco-resort on Marlon Brando's private island. Features 35 secluded villas with private plunge pools situated on white-sand beaches frequented by sea turtles and exotic birds. Access is via private plane.

name: Chalet Zermatt Peak
description: A premier luxury chalet perched high above the village of Zermatt, offering uninterrupted panoramic views of the Matterhorn. Includes a private chef, in-house wellness center, and ski-in/ski-out capabilities.

name: Necker Island
description: Sir Richard Branson's private island paradise. Can be booked exclusively for up to 40 guests. Offers unparalleled privacy, pristine beaches, and endless water sports, along with a staff of 100 to cater to every whim.

name: Laucala Island Resort
description: A 3,500-acre private island featuring 25 spectacular villas set amidst coconut plantations, sandy beaches, and volcanic mountains. Offers an 18-hole championship golf course and deep-sea submarine adventures.

name: Cheval Blanc Randheli
description: Designed by Jean-Michel Gathy, this LVMH property redefines Maldivian luxury. Features loft-style villas over crystal-clear waters, a Guerlain Spa on its own island, and a fleet of private seaplanes.

name: Ritz-Carlton Reserve, Dorado Beach
description: An ultra-luxury sanctuary situated on a former plantation. Offers deeply immersive cultural and wellness experiences, oceanfront villas with plunge pools, and the unique five-acre Spa Botánico.

name: One&Only Gorilla's Nest
description: Cushioned in the foothills of the breathtaking Virunga Volcano range, this ultra-luxury lodge is the ultimate base for mountain gorilla trekking. Treehouse-style suites blur the lines between indoors and nature.

name: Royal Mansour
description: Commissioned by King Mohammed VI, this masterpiece of Moorish architecture replaces rooms with private multi-story riads. Staff access riads via underground tunnels to ensure absolute privacy for guests.

name: The Plaza Hotel - Royal Suite
description: A 4,500 square-foot three-bedroom suite overlooking Fifth Avenue and the Pulitzer Fountain. Features Versailles-inspired decor, a grand piano, private elevator access, and 24-karat gold-plated fixtures.

name: Burj Al Arab Jumeirah
description: The world's most iconic luxury hotel, known for its sail-shaped silhouette. Offers duplex suites with panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf, chauffeur-driven Rolls-Royces, and an acclaimed underwater restaurant.

name: Singita Sasakwa Lodge
description: Perched on a rocky promontory with endless views of the Serengeti plains. Combines Edwardian manor grandeur with world-class wildlife viewing. Features grand suites with private infinity pools.

name: Amangiri
description: A spectacular modernist resort blending seamlessly into the dramatic red-rock landscape of the American Southwest. Features a vast Aman Spa, private pavilions, and exclusive access to slot canyons.

name: Villa d'Este
description: A 16th-century princely residence set on the shores of Lake Como. Surrounded by 25 acres of legendary gardens, offering timeless Renaissance elegance, a floating pool on the lake, and world-class Italian cuisine.

name: Octopus Superyacht
description: One of the world's largest and most recognizable superyachts available for charter. Features two helipads, a submarine, a glass-bottom pool, a music recording studio, and a crew of 60.

name: Fregate Island Private
description: A jewel of conservation in the Indian Ocean. Features 16 beautifully crafted villas integrated into the coastal landscape. Guests share the island with giant Aldabra tortoises and rare exotic birds.

name: The Post Oak Hotel
description: Texas' most luxurious destination, featuring a multi-million dollar art collection, a two-story Rolls-Royce showroom, and a sprawling spa. The Penthouse suite offers its own helipad access.

name: Badrutt's Palace Hotel
description: The ultimate destination for the winter jet set. Overlooking Lake St. Moritz, this historic hotel boasts legendary parties, a sprawling spa carved into rock, and ski concierges to arrange everything.

name: Four Seasons Tented Camp Golden Triangle
description: An immersive jungle experience where guests stay in ultra-luxury tents overlooking Myanmar and Laos. Offers ethical elephant interactions, jungle treks, and an open-air spa hidden in the bamboo forest.

name: Rosewood Castiglion del Bosco
description: An 800-year-old Tuscan estate situated in the UNESCO-protected Val d'Orcia. Features restored farmhouses turned luxury villas, a historic winery, and an 18-hole private golf course.
